materiality_analysis.reason: The 2024 disclosure explicitly references a table for carrying values of general and limited partnership interests, whereas the 2023 disclosure included detailed text describing that these amounts included 'any related performance-based income in the form of carried interest' and measurement basis ('measured based on NAV...'). The 2024 version omits this descriptive context and relies on the table. While the financial data remains, the removal of the explanatory text regarding the composition (specifically carried interest) and measurement methodology in the narrative is a meaningful narrowing of the disclosure substance.
